title: Category Pair · Classic
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Category Pair · Classic with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose two broad categories, such as foods and colors. The lead says one item fitting the first category and one fitting the second. The group agrees both items fit their assigned categories. Each player takes two turns. Give the lead one point for each successful turn. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Category Pair, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The group agrees both items fit their assigned categories.
recall.why: The group agrees both items fit their assigned categories.
